question: Does GIADA retain its one-step soma-voltage advantage over the 8,002-parameter Branch-ELM core when both are trained and evaluated on the validated event-rich S1e corpus?

registered_metrics.primary: median final raw soma RMSE across three seeds
secondary: median RMSE on absolute voltage transitions at least 5 mV
median RMSE on somatic -55 mV upcrossing transitions
mini scaling law at 100, 300, 1000 and 3000 steps

decision_rule.primary_pass: GIADA median final overall RMSE is lower than Branch-ELM
decision_rule.active_pass: GIADA median final active-stratum RMSE is lower than Branch-ELM
decision_rule.seed_robustness_pass: GIADA wins at least two of three seeds
